title: Pressed Pesto, Mozzarella and Tomato Panini
summary: Oiled crusty bread is spread with pesto, layered with mozzarella, blotted tomato and basil, and pressed in a pan under a weight for about 4 minutes, then 2-3 minutes on the second side.
equipment: large non-stick frying pan, or a panini press
a heavy saucepan or second pan to weigh the sandwiches

ingredients.item: slices crusty country bread, 1 cm thick (about 340 g)

steps.title: Blot the tomatoes
steps.text: Lay the tomato slices on paper towels for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Oil the bread
steps.text: Brush one side of each slice with oil.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread pesto on the unoiled side, then layer mozzarella, tomato, basil and more mozzarella.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Cook under a heavy pan over medium heat about 4 minutes until deep golden.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Turn and press 2-3 minutes more until the cheese melts.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest 2 minutes and cut on the diagonal.

tips: Blotting the tomato stops the bread steaming.
Cheese on both sides of the tomato glues the sandwich together.
Start in a cold pan so the bread toasts evenly.
storage: Best eaten warm. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and re-crisp in a dry pan.
